entries.quality_assessment: High-value real company photo — sharp focus on the HAMM roller, good exposure, wide-frame showing full road context. Has white text 'TECNOPAVI / Pavimentação' overlaid in lower center. The text overlay is acceptable for hero use under a scrim — the machine is the dominant visual. Wide 960x354 landscape format is ideal for full-bleed hero.
entries.fingerprint_summary: Real field photo: yellow-and-red HAMM tandem vibratory roller compacting freshly laid black CBUQ asphalt on a highway lane bordered by metal guard-rail, daylight. Brand text overlaid. The strongest and most authentic asset for this site — signals legitimacy and real machinery.

entries.quality_assessment: Square 315x315 — branded composite, same roller scene cropped square with the Tecnopavi logo and wordmark composited over. Professional graphic layout. Lower resolution than the cover (315px). Best for OG/social card and fallback — NOT a distinct gallery image since it shows the same scene as hamm-roller-hero.png.
entries.fingerprint_summary: Square branded tile: the HAMM roller/asphalt scene from cover, cropped square, with Tecnopavi geometric logo mark (yellow left triangle + orange right arrow) and 'TECNOPAVI Pavimentação' wordmark composited over the roller. Social/OG card format.
